settings.subtitle: Webhooks, sending and the app
settings.about_text: Screensaver → Discord {version}. A portable utility that installs nothing; sending happens only through the webhook URL.
common.need_profile: Add a webhook profile first (Settings → Profiles). Open settings?
settings.help_step1: 1. Open the channel → Channel settings → Integrations → Webhooks.
settings.help_step2: 2. Click “New Webhook”, set a name and avatar.
settings.help_step3: 3. “Copy Webhook URL” → paste it here and hit “Save”.
settings.help_note: Screenshots are always sent through the webhook. The app never asks for or stores Discord tokens.
capture.overlay_hint: Enter — capture · 1–3 — pick mode · Esc — cancel
settings.no_profiles: Add a webhook profile in Settings first.
capture.hotkey_unavailable: Couldn’t grab: {combos} — Windows gave them to another app. They still work inside the app’s window.
album.import_hint: Attach existing forum posts by pasting their links (no bot needed)
import.title: Attach existing posts
import.subtitle: A webhook cannot list forum threads, so paste links to the posts you need (right-click the post → “Copy Link”), one per line. Posts created by this app recover their name automatically; others get “Thread <id>” (fixable via “Rename”).
import.start_number_hint: The first sent file gets this number (1 by default).
import.need_links: Paste at least one valid link.
import.bad_start_number: Number must be a positive integer.
import.all_skipped: The selected posts are already in the album registry.
import.resolved_suffix: (names recovered for {resolved} of {total} — the rest are “Thread <id>”).
settings.hotkey_hint: PrintScreen is the default, but Windows usually claims it (“Snipping Tool”) — the app then never receives the key and the overlay does not open. Click the field and press your own combo, e.g. F9 or Ctrl+Shift+Q. Works on top of fullscreen games (low-level hook). If the game runs as Administrator, run the app the same way — and pick a key the game does not use, as it will be swallowed globally.
settings.hotkey_rejected: That combo is reserved (Ctrl+Shift+S / Ctrl+Shift+R are built in) or unsupported. Try another one, e.g. F9.
settings.hotkey_rebind_failed: Windows refused {combo} — the Snipping Tool or another app grabbed it first. Try a different combo.
